written_before: any outcome-dependent number (model-vs-price, model-vs-settlement, or P&L) was computed. Already known when writing: the published RESULTS_NBA.md holdout aggregates, market metadata counts (number of markets per family and result category yes/no/scalar), and candle coverage counts per month. No candle price was joined to any model probability or settlement before this file was hashed.
question: Are frozen Projection Foundation conditional player-prop probabilities better than, or selectively better than, archived Kalshi prices on 2025-26 regular-season points/rebounds/assists/threes ladders, net of fees?

model.configuration: the frozen holdout winners in results/frozen_params.json: points E_lightgbm + empirical; rebounds F_stack + minutes mixture; assists E_lightgbm + minutes mixture; threes F_stack + minutes mixture; minutes model E_lightgbm (no injury input). The frozen holdout configuration does NOT use the archived 2025-26 T-60 injury report (E_inj is a separate, non-frozen track), so the injury report is not used.
model.frame: conditional on the player playing (minutes > 0 in the ESPN box), the frame Kalshi props settle in
model.walk_forward: as in nba.pipeline.run_compute: lagged features use strictly earlier games; LightGBM trained on seasons 2021..2025 (hoopR labels) and applied to all 2025-26 games; all OLS/stack/distribution parameters fitted on development seasons and frozen
model.faithfulness_check: recomputed best model, distribution, parameters and pooled 2024-25+2025-26 holdout CRPS/MAE must match frozen_params.json / backtest_raw.json (CRPS within 0.005, same best/dist). If not, stop and report instead of substituting a model.
model.box_data: sportsdataverse hoopR mirror restored from sift-data-vault archives/NBA/espn_pbp_boxes_schedules/2002-2027/sportsdataverse/snapshot-20261116
model.rung_semantics: Kalshi floor_strike s (e.g. 19.5) titled 'k+' with k = s + 0.5; YES iff stat >= k, i.e. stat > s. Model probability = P(X >= ceil(s)) from the pmf. Verified by agreement of box-score stat >= k with official yes/no results.

markets.universe: markets that have candles, whose event maps (date, away, home) to an ESPN 2025-26 REGULAR-SEASON game (season_type 2) and whose player maps by normalised name to an ESPN box row of that game. Playoff / play-in / unmatched markets are excluded and counted.
markets.player_matching: normalise yes_sub_title name (text before ':'): NFKD accent strip, lowercase, drop punctuation and suffixes jr/sr/ii/iii/iv, collapse spaces; exact match within the two teams' box rows of the game; fallback unique (first initial + last name) match within the game; else unmatched (counted).
markets.tip_off: ESPN game_date_time (hoopR player box) in UTC. Kalshi metadata only carries occurrence_datetime for a minority of markets; expected_expiration_time - tip is reported as a sanity check.
markets.game_date_for_splits: ESPN tip-off converted to America/New_York calendar date

settlement_truth.source: sift-data-vault archives/NBA/kalshi_official_settlements/all-to-20261116/kalshi_public_api/snapshot-20261116, NBA/<series>.historical.jsonl and .live.jsonl (union by ticker; historical wins on conflict)
settlement_truth.rule: official result field: 'yes' -> 1, 'no' -> 0; 'scalar' (player active but did not take the court, settled at a fair price) and anything else -> void, excluded and counted. Box-score disagreement with the official result is reported separately; the official result is always the truth.
settlement_truth.dnp: contracts whose player did not play per the box but settled yes/no are counted and excluded from the model comparison (no conditional pmf row)

entry_quote.candle: the hourly candle with the largest end_period_ts such that tip - 24h <= end_period_ts <= tip - 60 min. If none exists, the contract is unquoted.
entry_quote.executable: that candle's (yes_bid.close, yes_ask.close) must classify as TWO_SIDED under nba.live.kalshi_report.classify_quote (bid > 0.02 or ask < 0.98 is not a placeholder; bid > 0 and ask < 1; ask >= bid). Candles carry no sizes, so the size requirement of executable_quote cannot be applied (limitation). A non-executable last candle means the contract is skipped (no search for an earlier candle).

fees.rounded_C1: ceil(100 * 0.07 * 1 * P * (1 - P)) / 100 dollars per contract (computed with a 1e-9 guard against float error)
fees.primary: unrounded (it defines R1-R3 net edge); P&L, ROI and CIs are reported under both

diagnostics_all_quoted_contracts.sample: every quoted contract with a yes/no official result and a model row (all rungs, not one per player-game)
metrics: Brier and log loss (p clipped to [1e-4, 1-1e-4]) of model vs mid
calibration slope: logistic y ~ a + b*logit(p), separately for model and mid
logistic y ~ a + b1*logit(model) + b2*logit(mid), game-clustered SEs (statsmodels cov_type=cluster on ESPN game id)
reliability table on fixed model-probability bins [0,0.1),...,[0.9,1.0]: n, mean model p, mean mid, hit rate

selection_rules.net_edge: YES: p - yes_price - fee_u(yes_price); NO: (1 - p) - no_price - fee_u(no_price), fee_u = unrounded fee. Side = the side with the larger net edge (only a positive one can qualify).
selection_rules.R1: net edge >= 0.05; then at most one contract per (player, game, family): the one with the largest net edge.
selection_rules.R2: restrict to contracts whose entry price on the chosen side is in [0.25, 0.75]; then R1.
selection_rules.R3: restrict to contracts with |p - mid| <= 0.15; then R1.
selection_rules.order: filters (R2 price, R3 agreement) are applied to contract-sides BEFORE choosing the one contract per player-game-family
selection_rules.pnl: per contract: win -> 1 - price - fee; loss -> -price - fee
report_per_rule: break-even win probability = avg price + avg fee
game-clustered bootstrap 95% CI for ROI (2,000 resamples, numpy default_rng(7), resampling ESPN game ids with replacement)
one-sided exact binomial p-value of wins vs break-even (informational)
splits: season half: game date < 2026-02-01 (Oct-Jan) vs >= 2026-02-01 (Feb-Apr regular season)

exploratory_then_confirmation.candidate_grid: subsets of the R1 bets defined by: family (4), side (2), entry-price bucket (4), family x side (8) = 18 subgroups
exploratory_then_confirmation.selection_strict: first-half n >= 30 AND ROI (unrounded fee) > 0 AND bootstrap 95% CI lower bound > 0
exploratory_then_confirmation.selection_lenient: first-half n >= 30 AND ROI (unrounded fee) >= 0.05 (reported separately; weaker evidence)
exploratory_then_confirmation.survival: second-half ROI (unrounded fee) > 0 = 'survived one forward split (point estimate)'; additionally CI lower bound > 0 = 'survived one forward split with CI above 0'. Never called a validated edge. Every other subgroup number is EXPLORATORY.

prediction_quality: on quoted player-games (player-game-family with >= 1 quoted contract with yes/no result): model CRPS of the full pmf against the box stat, and mean Brier over the quoted rungs for model vs mid, by family; reported separately from betting results.
amendments_policy: this file is never edited after hashing. Bugs are recorded in report.json -> amendments with reason, and the original result is kept alongside the amended one.
